 Print The Punjab Subordinate Services Selection Board (PSSSB) has released the admit card for the Group D recruitment examination 2026. Candidates appearing for the written examination can download their hall tickets from the board’s official website, sssb.punjab.gov.in, using their registration number and date of birth. The PSSSB Group D written examination is scheduled to be held on October 25, 2026. The recruitment drive aims to fill 2,098 vacancies for posts including Sewadar, Chowkidar and Safai Sewak in various Punjab government departments. Candidates must download their admit cards before the examination and check the details mentioned on them carefully. The hall ticket will be required to appear for the written examination. PSSSB Group D admit card 2026: Steps to download hall tickets
 Candidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the PSSB Group D admit card 2026 on the official website: Visit the official website, sssb.punjab.gov.in.
 Look for the link to download the PSSSB Group D admit card 2026 on the homepage or recruitment section.
 Click on the relevant admit card link.
 Enter your registration number and date of birth in the required fields.
 Submit the login details to access the admit card.
 Check the details mentioned on the hall ticket and download the document.
 Take a printout of the admit card for use on the examination day.
 Alternatively, candidates can click on the link provided here to download the PSSB Group D admit card 2026. Candidates are advised to stay tuned to the official website to get the complete details of the PSSB Group D recruitment process.
